exposure: Pre-existing chronic diseases (asthma, eczema, allergic rhinitis, diabetes, hypertension)
cohort: The study included 323,359 deliveries from pregnant Ontario women before and during the COVID-19 pandemic.
finding: During the COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario, C-section rates and physician visits increased, while preterm birth, NICU admission, and ED visits decreased, with these effects being more pronounced in women with pre-existing chronic conditions.
mod_finding: The odds of C-section delivery during the pandemic period were 9% higher compared to the pre-pandemic period.
cross-section timing: Compared outcomes from two periods: June 2018-February 2020 (pre-pandemic) and July 2020-March 2022 (during pandemic).
